Djot output format produces djot-compatible markup

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"output_format\":\"Djot\"}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p>Simple paragraph.</p>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content() as Any)
```
